evaluationProcedure: Verify all seals before reading evaluator-only content.
Preflight every available Qwen rule against each full rendered email; record all482pairs including unavailable rules and over-limit/failed calls.
One isolated local request per available pair per distinct Qwen method; no retries or best-of selection.
Evaluate both regex outcome predicates on the same full source HTML and retain errors, conflicts and matched source bytes.
Compare reported-fact and strict-predicate outputs separately against provisional independent labels; do not treat unreviewed/ambiguous pairs as negatives.
Publish only private aggregate reports with full denominators and shared-completed denominators; preserve every raw request/response and complete body hash.
No optimization, selection changes or live promotion after reserved material is opened.
annotationStatus: Independent single-author research annotations, not human-verified settlement gold; label categories and uncertainty must be preserved.
limits: Two new emails do not establish population accuracy or broad unseen-family generalization. Public questions were already development questions.
Email availability is later than prior snapshot; it does not by itself establish evidence available at original market settlement.
Successful lexical/semantic judgments are not authenticated onchain settlements.
Prompt-injection robustness remains unmeasured by this small natural sample.
sourceStatus: Raw .eml, full decoded main parts and signed/receipt metadata requested from independent author. Cryptographic verification must be distinguished from mere source availability.
